The image features a prominent, bright red comb with a serrated edge and a matching red wattle hanging below the beak. The plumage is primarily white, with some fine, hair-like feathers near the eye and ear area. The beak is short, curved, and pale yellow/grey. The eye is dark with a visible pupil and orange-brown iris. The texture of the red skin appears highly detailed, showing pores and small bumps.
